item.title: Mexican teen migrant dies in Florida jail holding ICE detainees
item.description: MIAMI (AP) — A 19-year-old Mexican migrant died at a county jail in Florida that has been holding immigrant detainees, according to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement. item.title: Unaccompanied migrant children continue showing up at border, data shows
item.description: Unaccompanied migrant children are crossing the Rio Grande from Mexico in highest numbers into South Texas since the start of this fiscal year, a data analysis by Border Report found.

item.title: Vance visits Austin for fundraiser with $50,000 cover charge
item.description: Vice President J.D. Vance is traveling to Austin to attend a fundraising event hosted by Palantir co-founder Joe Lonsdale, where donors must pledge $50,000 or more, while Texas State Rep. Christina Morales criticizes Vance for focusing on wealthy tech billionaires instead of working families.

item.title: California legislators pass bill to rename Cesar Chavez Day
item.description: The California Legislature kicked into overdrive as lawmakers work to rename Cesar Chavez Day following allegations of rape and sexual abuse against the formerly celebrated labor leader.
